bandReport.notes: Image->printed-page mapping VERIFIED against each footer and holds exactly as briefed: p12=23, p13=25, p14=27, p15=29, p17=31 (footer 'TFDD-A-HTM/37C' on every page). Seams checked and both are clean: p11 (printed 21) ends with Q60 complete, p17 ends with Q86 complete, and p18 (printed 33) opens at Q87 — no question straddles either seam. Q61-86 contiguous, 26 questions, no gaps. The Devanagari sliver at the left edge of the crop (facing Hindi page) was ignored on every page per the brief. Every option was read label-by-label off the page; high-zoom crops were used for the near-identical option sets (Q63 a-(cx/a) vs a-(ax/c) vs a+(ax/c) vs a+(cx/a); Q64 12x-24y-21 vs -19; Q66/Q67 sign variants; Q71 ten-digit binary strings) and for everything sitting under the red watermark. FOUR questions share the identical option set 'I only / II only / Both I and II / Neither I nor II' (Q73, Q76, Q78, Q86) — each was cropped and read independently rather than copied, and all four are in that same printed order in this booklet. Q78 statement II reads '(5,5) IN AxA and (1,3) IN AxA' — BOTH symbols are a plain 'in' (element-of) with NO slash; a low-resolution first pass looked like a not-element-of on the second, and it is not. Verified at 9x plus a watermark-removal pass that isolates the ink, and separately with a darkness-only threshold to recover the first symbol, which sits under the watermark. Q83's sign between x^3 and 10 is a PLUS, confirmed at 20x (a clear cross, both strokes) — the watermark crosses it and it reads ambiguously at page scale. No option anywhere in this band was unreadable.
